title: Maps from an acyclic complex to a bounded-below injective complex are null-homotopic
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $K^\bullet$ be an acyclic cochain complex and let $I^\bullet$ be a cochain complex which is zero below some degree and whose terms are injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Every morphism of complexes $u:K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ is chain-homotopic to zero.
